reforms.description: The Industrial Revitalisation Law was legislated to accord researchers intellectual property rights on government-sponsored research, while the government has decided to hand back intellectual property rights to private-sector researchers for research conducted on its behalf. Additionally, a special tax credit for incremental R&D expenditures was introduced to encourage firms to invest in research and development activities.
reforms.component_name: IP Rights and R&D Tax Credit
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Enhancing intellectual property rights and providing tax incentives are expected to stimulate R&D investment and innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: The Industrial Revitalisation Law was legislated and the tax credit was implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reforms represent significant structural changes in the management of intellectual property and funding for R&D.
reforms.source_quote: The government has decided to begin to hand back to private-sector researchers the intellectual property rights on research they have conducted on its behalf in order to encourage them to exploit its potential and thereby strengthen industrial competitiveness.

reforms.description: Numerous tax and lending programmes were introduced to encourage more start-ups and venture businesses as part of the Emergency Economic Measures.
reforms.component_name: Tax and Lending Programmes for Start-ups
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Encouraging start-ups through financial support is expected to foster innovation and job creation.
reforms.status_evidence: The tax and lending programmes were introduced as part of the Emergency Economic Measures.
reforms.importance_rationale: The introduction of tax and lending programmes represents a significant but narrower reform aimed at supporting start-ups.
reforms.source_quote: Numerous tax and lending programmes since the November 1998 Emergency Economic Measures.

reforms.description: The government is planning to set up a series of venture-capital funds in collaboration with the private sector to provide financial support to promising start-up companies.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Establishing venture-capital funds is expected to enhance financial support for start-ups, promoting innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The government is planning to set up the funds.
reforms.importance_rationale: The establishment of venture-capital funds represents a significant initiative to support start-ups but is not a major reform.
reforms.source_quote: The government is also planning to join with the private sector to set up a series of venture-capital funds to provide cash to promising start-up companies.

reforms.description: The government implemented a revised law in January 1999 to support start-ups and promote venture businesses, aiming to create employment opportunities and encourage existing companies to develop new lines of business.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Supporting start-ups through legal reforms is expected to enhance innovation and job creation.
reforms.status_evidence: The revised law was implemented in January 1999.
reforms.importance_rationale: The revised law represents a significant but narrower reform aimed at supporting start-ups.
reforms.source_quote: A revised law was implemented in January 1999 to these ends. It also aimed to encourage existing companies that have abundant managerial resources, including technological and human resources, to make aggressive efforts towards the development and expansion of new lines of business based on this abundance.

reforms.description: The government has implemented changes to ease corporate restructuring, promote technological innovation, and encourage private sector venture risks by facilitating mergers and acquisitions, employee buyouts, and providing loans and credit insurance to start-ups and venture firms.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Facilitating corporate restructuring and providing financial support is expected to enhance innovation and economic dynamism.
reforms.status_evidence: The government has implemented these changes.
reforms.importance_rationale: The changes represent a major reform aimed at promoting innovation and restructuring within the corporate sector.
reforms.source_quote: The government has just made a number of changes that will ease corporate restructuring, promote technological innovation and encourage the private sector to take more business venture risks.
